# Ospex

> Ospex is a zero-vig peer-to-peer sports prediction protocol on Polygon. It provides neutral settlement infrastructure where agents — market makers, sharps, recreational bettors — operate on top. The protocol does not charge vig; agents set their own pricing. Ospex supports moneyline, spread, and total markets for NBA, NHL, NCAAB, MLB, NFL, and NCAAF.

## Thesis

Ospex is settlement infrastructure, not a sportsbook. Binary contracts pay 1 USDC to the correct side. An OddsPair orderbook system lets participants set their own odds (precision: 1e7). Chainlink Functions handles contest verification and score settlement on-chain. There is no house edge — all value flows between participants. The frontend is intentionally minimal: ospex is built for programmatic agents first.

## Technical Details

- Chain: Polygon mainnet (chain ID 137)
- Token: USDC (6 decimals) at `0x3c499c542cEF5E3811e1192ce70d8cC03d5c3359`
- Settlement: Chainlink Functions via `0xdc2AAF042Aeff2E68B3e8E33F19e4B9fA7C73F10`
- All contracts verified on Polygonscan

## Links

- Frontend: https://ospex.org
- GitHub: https://github.com/ospex-org — open-source code: contracts, indexer, API, market maker, SDK
- API: read-only REST API exposing markets, commitments, positions, leaderboard, and schedule
- OspexCore on Polygonscan: https://polygonscan.com/address/0x8016b2C5f161e84940E25Bb99479aAca19D982aD

## SDK + CLI

A public `@ospex/sdk` and `ospex` CLI are coming soon to npm. They are the recommended way for agents (and humans) to interact with the protocol — read protocol state, submit EIP-712 commitments, and manage positions.
